items.label: 🌟 OFFICE READY OUT OF THE BOX
items.value: This 2-in-1 tablet PC arrives with MS Office¹ 2024 pre-installed, making it ready for productivity the moment you power it on. Whether you use the touchscreen interface, the detachable keyboard, or the on-screen keyboard for quick input, it’s designed to function as both a compact microcomputer and a capable personal computer.

items.label: 🚀 POWERFUL PERFORMANCE
items.value: Powered by the Core² m3-8100Y processor, this sleek tablet computer brings the speed of a modern mini computer with 2 cores, 4 threads, and turbo up to 3.40 GHz. It handles everyday tasks, apps, and I/O operations efficiently—ideal for work, browsing, entertainment, and even light creative use with a stylus or light pen.

items.label: 📊 MULTITASKING MADE EASY
items.value: With 12 GB³ RAM, you can run multiple apps smoothly—perfect for productivity or media streaming. The 256 GB⁴ SSD provides fast, reliable storage, and thanks to the responsive touch screen, managing files is simple through intuitive gestures like drag and drop, whether you treat the device as a personal digital assistant or a small Pocket PC for travel.

items.label: 🖥️ VIBRANT VISUALS
items.value: The 10.1-inch⁵ display with 1280 × 800 resolution delivers crisp visuals and vivid colors. Combined with the precise touchpad on the detachable keyboard and the flexibility of the virtual keyboard, you get a laptop-like experience in a highly portable form factor.

items.label: 🔆 ULTRA PORTABLE DESIGN⁶
items.value: Designed for mobility, this 2-in-1 device easily switches between tablet and notebook modes. Its lightweight chassis makes it ideal for commuting or travel, while the high-resolution webcam ensures clear, professional video calls—adding to its versatility as a modern personal computer replacement.

items.label: 🎵 IMMERSIVE AUDIO EXPERIENCE
items.value: The premium speakers deliver rich surround sound for movies, games, and music. With its 7.6V/3400mAh battery, this tablet PC keeps you engaged for hours, functioning smoothly as both an entertainment hub and a compact microcomputer.

items.label: 🔧 CONNECTIVITY AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
items.value: Equipped with a fully functional⁷ USB-C I/O port, a dedicated USB-C power input, and a micro HDMI port, the device ensures broad compatibility for accessories and displays. Bluetooth 5.0 and WiFi 5 keep your wireless connections fast and reliable.

items.label: 📦 COMPLETE PACKAGE
items.value: Inside the AE86 tablet laptop box, you’ll find everything needed to get started: the detachable keyboard, a responsive stylus pen, and the sleek tablet itself. With the included user manual and power adapter, setup is effortless and immediate.
